notes: Deliberately ambiguous; the analysis should surface unknowns and assumptions, not facts.

known_facts.statement: There is an existing system that the user wants to make faster.

assumptions.statement: The user considers speed more important than other qualities.
A baseline measurement of the current speed is available.

options.statement: Cache the hot paths that are called most often.
Parallelize independent work where the dependencies allow it.

open_questions.statement: Clarify which operation is slow and by how much.
